title: Is there (debloated) local LLM model that works best for web dev js, sql, python, php, css
body:
I am limited by 12GB vram and I want something purely for webdev coding where model does not know about chemistry, history etc all non-related training and purely and only optimized for coding only. As there are other models like qwen coders etc but they dont match frontier level models. I dont know how hard it is to train own model but wondering if anyone, any lab has made model so lightweight but perfectly trained on coding only?

submitted by /u/HsSekhon
summaryZh: 用户正在寻找一个能在12GB显存限制下运行，且专门针对Web开发编码任务优化的本地LLM模型。用户希望模型只专注于编码，避免无关领域的训练。
